turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Our statement has so many fees that I cannot tell what we are paying for.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We can separate interchange, network charges, and processor markup, then compare the effective rate against transaction mix. That makes the review more useful than a headline rate.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So you cannot promise savings before seeing the statement?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Exactly. We should check the figures first, including monthly fees and contract terms. Then you can judge a comparison based on the whole cost.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is helpful. Could we review the details tomorrow afternoon?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Certainly, Mateo. In this demo, we would capture those notes and request a suitable appointment.
